title: ExpenseMate - Personal Finance Tracker
description: Production-ready full-stack personal finance tracking application
fullDescription: ExpenseMate is a modern, full-stack web application designed to help users track their personal finances effortlessly. Built with professional development practices, it provides a secure, intuitive, and responsive interface for managing income and expenses. This project showcases clean architecture, secure authentication, real-time data synchronization, responsive UI/UX design, RESTful API design, database security rules, and production deployment strategies.
features: 🔐 Secure Authentication - Email/password & Google OAuth with JWT and session persistence
💸 Complete Expense Management - Add, edit, delete transactions with categorization and notes
📊 Real-time Dashboard - Instant financial overview with income/expense tracking and balance calculation
🎨 Modern UI/UX - Dark mode, responsive design, toast notifications, and loading states
🔒 Enterprise Security - Firebase Auth, Firestore security rules, CORS protection, and rate limiting
📱 Mobile-First Design - Works seamlessly on all devices with real-time updates
technicalDecisions: Firebase Authentication & Firestore for industry-standard auth and NoSQL database
React 18 + Vite for lightning-fast build tool and modern UI development
Express.js backend with Firebase Admin SDK for secure server-side operations
Tailwind CSS for utility-first, responsive design system
JWT token verification with BCrypt password hashing for enhanced security
Helmet.js for security headers and Express Rate Limit for API protection
CORS configuration and input validation for robust API security
Firebase Hosting + Render deployment for production-ready hosting

architecture.frontend: React SPA with component-based architecture, auth context, protected routes
architecture.backend: Express.js RESTful API with middleware, controllers, and services
architecture.database: Cloud Firestore with security rules and data validation
architecture.auth: Firebase Authentication with JWT tokens and role-based access

title: RANKED - Gamified Social Media Platform
description: Enterprise-grade RPG-style social network with gamification engine
fullDescription: RANKED transforms social networking into an RPG-style competitive experience where every action earns XP and every user climbs the leaderboard. Built to demonstrate enterprise-level Spring Boot development, this platform features a complete gamification system with 50 progressive levels, 25+ achievement badges, daily streak multipliers, and global leaderboards. The architecture showcases Spring Batch expertise for batch processing, SOLID principles, clean code architecture, and production-ready deployment strategies.
screenshot: /images/RANKED - Gamified Social Media Platform - Google Chrome 2026-01-22 22-10-17.mp4
features: 🎮 Complete Gamification System - XP for every action, 50 progressive levels (Novice to Legendary)
🏆 Achievement Engine - Unlock 25+ unique badges with daily streak multipliers
📊 Global Leaderboards - Compete with users worldwide in real-time rankings
🔐 Enterprise Authentication - JWT-based stateless auth with BCrypt and role-based access (USER/ADMIN)
📱 Modern Responsive UI - Bold competitive design, dark mode optimized, mobile-first approach
⚡ Real-time Updates - Animated XP progress bars, achievement notifications, instant feedback
technicalDecisions: Spring Batch for background gamification jobs - XP calculation, level progression, badge assignment, leaderboard generation, streak maintenance
Spring Boot 3.2.1 with Java 17 for modern enterprise-grade backend architecture
Spring Security with JWT tokens for stateless authentication and session management
Spring Data MongoDB with MongoDB Atlas for cloud-hosted, scalable NoSQL database
BCrypt password hashing with configurable strength for enhanced security
React 18 + Vite 5 for modern frontend with fast development and optimized builds
Tailwind CSS 3.4 for utility-first, responsive design with dark mode support
Maven for dependency management and build automation
CORS configuration for secure cross-origin requests
Clean architecture with layer separation - Controllers, Services, Repositories, DTOs
Global exception handling with custom error responses
DTO pattern for API responses to prevent data leakage

architecture.backend: Spring Boot with layered architecture - Auth, User, Social, Gamification modules
architecture.frontend: React SPA with context API, protected routes, and API service layer
architecture.database: MongoDB Atlas with indexed collections for performance
architecture.security: JWT + Spring Security with role-based access control
architecture.batch: Spring Batch jobs for scheduled gamification calculations
